10 resources and exactly how to use each one.
Come back in September dangerous.

THE SUMMER EE GLOW-UP
@1nska  |  THE BUILD LIST

Most EE students waste the summer and wonder why they feel
behind in September.
Three months is enough time to go from someone who studies circuits to someone who
builds things people do not believe came out of a dorm room. The resources below are
the fastest path. But a list is not a plan, so this guide tells you exactly how to
use each one and how to stack them into a real summer. Every resource has a link.
Tap the name to open it.

Do not try to do all 10. Pick 3 that point at the same job and go deep.
Depth is what gets you hired and what makes content nobody can fake. A
checklist is not a skill.
